sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows 2376 ppm defects (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 45.15 per unit (po:4500014429-10, po:4500014373-10, po:4500014306-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Thanks for the numbers, we see the volume bump and your scorecard, so we can tighten our quality commitment to 2500 ppm to match reality. I can offer 46.00 EUR per unit with this better ppm limit, which is a fair step forward. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €46.00 per unit, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Faster payment is what we really need right now, so if we can agree on that or a higher volume, it would be great. Which volume can you commit to?

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

why.tactician: The supplier has repeated €45.50 four times, and the only lever it names (payment days) is fixed, so further counters are unlikely to gain anything. The alternative rungs (E0 at €45.33, step rungs €45.35–45.37) would save at most about €2.7k, or roughly 0.36 % of C, if it gave way. That is small next to the risk of stalling with a supplier that is already under strain. Its own sheet keeps the best quality terms: ppm 300 with no chargeback. Every other option adds a ppm or chargeback change that costs us more C than it saves. Accepting at C €750,082 is far below the no-deal alternative of €894,383, and it secures the single source on our quality-first goal. We already got €1.50 off the opening price plus the ppm improvement.
